messages.text: You have a fund for branches: you may delegate an investigation to a researcher of its own while you go on. One branch worth considering: examine which assumptions keep this investigation on quadratic solutions, develop an alternative with a different mechanism, and name an experiment that decides whether it deserves to be followed - concluding that it is not promising is a result too. Ask for an explanation of the mechanism, its conditions of application, a first contrast and the evidence behind it, not a list of ideas. Whether to delegate, and what to ask, is yours to decide; keep enough of your rounds to read its result, test it and decide whether to change direction.
